description: An awareness edition of about 10 minutes for all staff, on the defending side only. A mixed run of the year's messages across email, calls, a voicemail, a text, a sign-in prompt and a web page, from three fictional companies. Your organiser places your existing role post-check after it, which compares against your role pre-check. Each answer is explained, and reporting when you're unsure is always fine and never marked down.
